evidence.note: User's hand reaches the edge of the closed refrigerator door.
Main refrigerator compartment is visibly open and illuminated.
Refrigerator remains open while the user grasps its outer edge to close it.
Refrigerator door is fully closed and the interior is no longer visible.

events.object_description: Main food-compartment door of the stainless-steel refrigerator; on means open.

evidence.note: Both hinged wood doors of the upper cabinet above the range hood appear closed.
One cabinet-door leaf has opened, exposing the cabinet interior.
The first-opened cabinet leaf remains open.
Both leaves are still open as the user begins the closing sequence.
The upper cabinet is fully closed.

events.object_description: First-opened hinged wood door leaf of the upper cabinet above the range hood; on means open.

evidence.note: Only the first cabinet leaf is clearly open; the second leaf has not yet been opened.
The user manipulates the second cabinet-door leaf.
Both separate cabinet-door leaves are visibly open.
Both leaves remain open before the closing manipulation.
The user is closing the cabinet doors and this leaf appears at or near its closed position.
Both cabinet leaves are closed.

events.object_description: Second-opened hinged wood door leaf of the upper cabinet above the range hood; on means open.

evidence.note: User reaches for the handle of the top drawer immediately to the right of the oven.
The top drawer is pulled open, exposing utensils and stored items.
The same top drawer remains open.
User pushes the open drawer inward.
The drawer front is flush with the cabinet and fully closed.

events.object_description: Top utensil/storage drawer immediately to the right of the oven; on means open.

notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two separately hinged upper-cabinet leaves are reported independently; their exact closing order is somewhat ambiguous because both are manipulated within the short interval from frames 592 to 608.
scene_description: A person moves through a compact kitchen and manipulates the refrigerator, the two hinged doors of an upper cabinet above the cooktop, and a top drawer beside the oven.
